title: Project: Asynchronous Job Processing System
summary: Build a retry policy, a bounded worker-pool job queue with a dead-letter queue, and the system that wires them together.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: exponential backoff with a cap, retryability decisions, one result per job, ordered results and statistics.

rubric.label: Concurrency
rubric.description: The concurrency cap is never exceeded, no accepted job is lost when a sibling fails, and shutdown drains in-flight work rather than cancelling or abandoning it.
